## Step 1: Kill 当前 GSM8K eval (cuda:0) 并重启到 cuda:1
```bash
echo "=== Killing eval PID 22359 ==="
kill 22359 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
ps aux | grep 22359 | grep -v grep && echo "STILL RUNNING" || echo "KILLED OK"

echo "=== Restarting eval on cuda:1 ==="
cd /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001 && \
source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate && \
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && \
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 nohup python evaluate.py \
  --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-7B \
  --adapter-path /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-7B_d000_s42/lora_adapter \
  --output-dir /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/eval_results/Qwen2.5-7B_d000_s42 \
  --benchmarks gsm8k \
  --batch-size 4 \
  > /root/autodl-tmp/logs/eval_7b_d000_s42_gsm8k.log 2>&1 &
EVAL_PID=$!
echo "GSM8K eval PID: $EVAL_PID (cuda:1)"
sleep 5
tail -3 /root/autodl-tmp/logs/eval_7b_d000_s42_gsm8k.log 2>/dev/null
```

## Step 2: 启动 Qwen2.5-7B d005 s42 on cuda:0
```bash
echo "=== Launching 7B d005 s42 on cuda:0 ==="
mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-7B_d005_s42
mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/logs

cd /root/contamcal-irt-calibration && \
source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate && \
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 nohup python exp001/train_sft.py \
  --model-name /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-7B \
  --data-path /root/autodl-tmp/sft_data/sft_dosage_005.jsonl \
  --output-dir /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-7B_d005_s42 \
  --seed 42 --lr 5e-5 --lora-r 16 --lora-alpha 32 \
  --batch-size 2 --grad-accum 8 --epochs 1 --max-seq-length 2048 \
  > /root/autodl-tmp/logs/train_7b_d005_s42.log 2>&1 &
D005_PID=$!
echo "7B d005 s42 PID: $D005_PID (cuda:0)"
```

## Step 3: 检查 14B 下载状态
```bash
echo "=== 14B STATUS ==="
INCOMPLETE_14B=$(find /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B/ -name "*.incomplete" | wc -l)
SAFETENSORS_14B=$(ls /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B/*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "14B: incomplete=$INCOMPLETE_14B, safetensors=$SAFETENSORS_14B"
du -sh /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B/
```

## Step 4: 如果 14B 就绪，启动 14B d000 s42 on cuda:2
```bash
if [ "$INCOMPLETE_14B" -eq 0 ] && [ "$SAFETENSORS_14B" -ge 8 ]; then
  echo "=== 14B READY - launching on cuda:2 ==="
  mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-14B_d000_s42
  cd /root/contamcal-irt-calibration && \
  source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate && \
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 nohup python exp001/train_sft.py \
    --model-name /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B \
    --data-path /root/autodl-tmp/sft_data/sft_dosage_000.jsonl \
    --output-dir /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Qwen2.5-14B_d000_s42 \
    --seed 42 --lr 5e-5 --lora-r 16 --lora-alpha 32 \
    --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 16 --epochs 1 --max-seq-length 2048 \
    > /root/autodl-tmp/logs/pilot_14b_d000_s42.log 2>&1 &
  echo "14B PILOT PID: $! (cuda:2)"
  
  echo "=== Waiting 30s for VRAM check ==="
  sleep 30
  nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader
  VRAM_USED=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i 2 | tr -d ' ')
  echo "14B cuda:2 VRAM: ${VRAM_USED} MiB"
  if [ "$VRAM_USED" -gt 85000 ]; then
    echo "WARNING: VRAM > 85GB! Need --gradient-checkpointing"
  else
    echo "VRAM OK (<85GB)"
  fi
  tail -5 /root/autodl-tmp/logs/pilot_14b_d000_s42.log 2>/dev/null
else
  echo "14B NOT READY (incomplete=$INCOMPLETE_14B, safetensors=$SAFETENSORS_14B)"
fi
```
